chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Shadhan, from Yahya ibn Abi Talhah, that he asked a righteous servant about a man who touched the private part of his wife or his bondwoman, playing with her until she emitted fluid: is ghusl obligatory upon her or not?
He said: Has she not emitted from desire? I said: Yes. He said: Ghusl is obligatory upon her.

key_terms.غُسْلٌ: The ritual bath that becomes obligatory after certain states

ai.seo_question: When does ghusl become obligatory upon a woman according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that when a woman emits fluid due to sexual desire, ghusl becomes obligatory upon her. The ruling applies based on the occurrence of emission from desire, indicating the cause for ritual purification.
